title: Tyrannosaurus Re(ge)x
body: In this question, the Python regular expression library has been imported as re. For all parts, you will only need to worry about the example strings given to you and may assume that these examples cover all edge cases. Congratulations to Mir on starting his new job at Triassic Park, an amusement park that brought dinosaurs back to life! His first task is to clean up some of the data records stored for the park’s dinosaurs. Two examples of these records are shown in the variables rex\_string and tri\_string below:\n##figure3.gif
